content_sections.heading: AIIMS Patna Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: A total of 18 vacancies are available - 1 for Superintending Engineer, 1 for Chief Librarian, 1 for Senior Analyst (System Analyst), 1 for Deputy Chief Security Officer, 1 for Hospital Architect, 1 for Senior Procurement-cum-Stores Officer, 1 for Executive Engineer (AC & R), 1 for Executive Engineer (Electrical), 1 for Chief Medical Social Service Officer, 1 for CSSD Officer, 2 for Senior Dietician (Assistant Food Manager), 3 for Accounts Officer, 1 for Security Officer, 1 for Chief Medical Record Officer, and 1 for Supervising Medical Social Service Officer.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for AIIMS Patna Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.aiimspatna.edu.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 10-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna Group 'A' Posts on Deputation?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the AIIMS Patna Group 'A' Posts on Deputation is 10-09-2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance of the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Group 'A' Posts on Deputation at AIIMS Patna?
faq.answer: There are a total of 18 vacancies for Group 'A' Posts on Deputation at AIIMS Patna. These vacancies are distributed across various specialized roles within the institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form from the official website and submit it via post or as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applying to these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Group 'A' Posts on Deputation is 56 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for specific categories in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. Generally, they range from a Graduate degree in Engineering, Science, Commerce, or Architecture to Master's degrees and Ph.D. in relevant fields, along with specific experience requirements.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. This makes the application process more accessible to all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: The salary for the selected candidates will be based on the 7th Central Pay Commission, ranging from Level-10 to Level-13, depending on the specific post. This includes a basic pay and other allowances.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Group 'A' Posts on Deputation?
faq.answer: The selection process involves application through the proper channel, followed by Vigilance Clearance, Document Verification, and APAR Assessment. These steps ensure that the most suitable candidates are selected.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of AIIMS Patna, which is www.aiimspatna.edu.in. It is crucial to refer to the official notification for detailed instructions.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for this recruitment is Deputation. This means that the selected candidates will be appointed on deputation from their parent department or organization.
